bullets.text: Companywide full-year CR finished at 95.8, yielding a 4.2% underwriting profit margin to beat the 4% target; PL CR was 96.0, CL was 91.1, while Property recorded a 110.5 CR.
Companywide NPW increased 10% YOY; Commercial Lines led expansion with a 17% gain to $9.4B, Personal Lines grew 9%, and Property advanced 8% to reach $2.4B.
Personal auto countrywide rate increases were about 9% in H1 and 4% in H2, following ~8% in 2021; Property raised portfolio rates ~19% on average to address profitability and catastrophe exposures.
Hurricane Ian, the largest in company history, generated estimated losses of $560M in PL and ~$15M in CL; Property reinsurance capped Ian losses and ALAE at $200M (8.8 pts).

Total investment portfolio return was -7.8% (fixed-income -6.6%, equities -19.4%); issued $1.5B of corporate bonds at ~3%; skipped the annual variable dividend while maintaining the $0.10/share quarterly common dividend.
Companywide PIF grew 3% YOY; Property PIF recognized modest 3% growth; Personal Lines ended 2022 with growth in both premiums and policies in force as market competitiveness improved during H2.
Prioritized profit over growth during H2 through expense management, primarily the media budget, and continued rate level management; these efforts resulted in Personal Lines finishing at a 96.0 CR.
HQX online purchasing expanded to 47 states plus DC, covering >90% of quoted consumers; BQX wrote BOP across 38 states (~70% of CMP market) and offered E&S brokerage access in 40 states.

Engagement index improved three points to rank in Gallup’s top 5%; 100% pay equity sustained; launched Name Your Cause foundation program; granted hundreds of 'Big Wishes' out of 9,000+ employee submissions.

'Unity' served as theme of the letter; Purpose revised to 'help people move forward and live fully'; Vision expanded to include business owners and other financial needs alongside consumers and agents.
